payload.reason: The evidence discusses the use of manual Pyramid scores in the context of evaluating summarization metrics, specifically in relation to the TAC 2014 dataset.

claims.text: Manual Pyramid scores are used as a semi-manual evaluation framework for summarization effectiveness.
Pyramid scoring organizes content units from gold human-written summaries in a structured manner.
The effectiveness of evaluation metrics is analyzed by correlating them with manual Pyramid scores.
